description: The figure is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating macro-averaged F1 results for predicting narrative frames under three prompting/labeling conditions across three model categories. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model names “Gemini,” “GPT4o,” and “Sonnet,” arranged left to right in that order, with three adjacent bars per model. The vertical axis is a numeric scale (linear) with tick marks labeled from 0.0 up to 0.7 in regular 0.1 intervals, representing the macro-averaged F1 values (no explicit y-axis title is shown). For each model group, the blue bar corresponds to “Basic prompt,” the orange bar to “Structured prompt + oracle,” and the green bar to “Structured prompt + predicted,” as indicated by the legend at the bottom. Approximate bar heights are: for Gemini, Basic prompt ≈0.32, Structured prompt + oracle ≈0.60, and Structured prompt + predicted ≈0.35; for GPT4o, Basic prompt ≈0.26, Structured prompt + oracle ≈0.58, and Structured prompt + predicted ≈0.46; for Sonnet, Basic prompt ≈0.34, Structured prompt + oracle ≈0.52, and Structured prompt + predicted ≈0.42. The bars are grouped by model with consistent within-group ordering (blue, orange, green), there is no visible sorting by value beyond the fixed category order, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized by annotations, outlines, or distinct shading beyond their color coding.
